integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically by reducing factors across the inserted central zero to factors of the original even prefix-normal palindrome. Exhaustive finite replay through length 23 independently checks the construction and published count data.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves a strict one-step odd-over-even inequality and an explicit injection, but not an exact formula for npal(n), the exact gap, or a classification of the remaining odd-length prefix-normal palindromes.
title: A center-zero injection for prefix-normal palindromes
